integrity: The value \(8\) and the existence of the published \(\mathcal A_5\) example are treated as prior. The new claim is the exact \(960\)-element census and four-class symmetry classification, with an explicit residual risk from unindexed or unpublished experimental data.
scientific_limitations: Finite exhaustive classification for complete deterministic binary automata on exactly five states; no general upper bound for larger state counts is claimed.
title: Four extremal five-state binary avoiding-threshold classes
